relations.name: Miso Butter Ramen
relations.rationale: The rich umami flavor of miso complements the deep chocolate notes in the cookies, creating a unique dessert pairing.

relations.name: Preserved Lemon Couscous
relations.rationale: The bright acidity of preserved lemon adds a refreshing contrast to the dense and chocolatey cookies.

relations.name: Vegetable and Beef Skillet
relations.rationale: A hearty savory dish like this skillet can balance the sweetness of the dark chocolate cookies.

relations.name: Dukkah
relations.rationale: While not directly related, dukkah's nutty and spiced flavor profile can offer a unique twist when paired as a dusting alongside the cookies.
